# Stories and Strategies

Stories and Strategies is two things.

## 1. A podcast production agency

Stories and Strategies is a successful podcast production agency. It helps major international brands, corporations, and people create, grow, and monetize podcasts, including shows that have won awards. It is based in Calgary, Canada, and is led by Doug Downs, Founder, and Emily Page, Co-Owner and Operations Lead.

Homepage: https://storiesandstrategies.ca/

## 2. Public Relations Stories and Strategies, the podcast

Public Relations Stories and Strategies is the world's most listened to public relations podcast, hosted by Doug Downs. It serves public relations and communications professionals, and leaders and brands who need to understand how PR actually works.

It offers in-depth conversations with PR leaders, practitioners, authors, and researchers about the strategies behind real work, including measurement, media pitching, crisis, reputation, and AI in communications. It is practitioner led and story driven, not theory driven, and goes behind the campaign to how the decision was made, what worked, what did not, and what listeners can use in their own work.

Host: Doug Downs
Episodes and transcripts: https://storiesandstrategies.ca/episodes/
Listen on Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/stories-and-strategies/id1512806323
